# `tls` check

Verify a TLS certificate chain and how many days it has left.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: tls
    target: example.com:443
    expect:
      days_left: { warn: 30d, fail: 7d }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` **(required)** | string |  | host or host:port (port defaults to 443). |
| `server_name` | string |  | Name to verify the certificate against (default: the host). |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.days_left` | {warn, fail} days | `{warn: 30d, fail: 7d}` | Days until the leaf certificate expires. Triggers when the value is below the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check tls <target> [--set key=value ...]`
